legal.title: Important Medical and Legal Notice
legal.p1: MediTrace is an assistive personal health records and adherence management tool. MediTrace does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or prescription services.
legal.p2: All information retrieved from national drug registries or AI assistance is for awareness purposes only. Never disregard professional medical advice or delay seeking it because of information provided by this application.
legal.emergency: For acute symptoms or emergencies, immediately contact local emergency services (112 or 108 in India) or visit the nearest emergency medical facility.
